=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2414-2428 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In `unblock_resolve_own_prs`, the check that decides whether to read MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_LABEL looks only at `.headRefName == $h and .state == "OPEN"` and skips the head-repository and author filters that `own_prs_from_graphql` (scripts/unblock_actions.py) applies, so an open `ai/issue-<n>` PR from a fork or another author triggers the variable read.
  WHY: If that read fails with anything other than 404, lines 2421-2423 set `graphql_file=""` and `reason=label_read_failed`, the own-PR facts become `unknown`, and `unblock_reissue_own_pr_guard` refuses the re-issue with `own_pr_unknown`, even though issue #10241 says such PRs are ignored by G1 to G3. When the read succeeds, the only cost is one extra actions/variables call per judge run. All reviewers rated this NIT (mapped to low). google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite reported it twice, under CORRECTNESS and PERFORMANCE, both times as an efficiency problem only.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "G5. ... G4 gets MERGE_LEASE_SOURCE_ISSUE_GUARD_ENABLED, default true" with "false keeps today's behaviour", and "Pass the two switches through the env: of the steps that run these scripts." (also lease test: "switch off restores today's grant")
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml, the merge-lease tick and base-sync env mappings (lines 263-270 / 267 and 1030-1043 / 1035) that already forward `MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED`
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: The PR does not modify review_autofix_sweep.yml, and grep finds no MERGE_LEASE_SOURCE_ISSUE_GUARD_ENABLED next to its two MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED mappings. The switch was added to orchestrate_poll.yml, review_autofix.yml and cancel_on_pr_close.yml only. A repository variable set to `false` therefore never reaches the sweep's lease paths (scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh, scripts/review_merge_train.sh), and the script default keeps the guard on there. README.md and agents.d/10241-unblock-reissue-own-pr-guard.md document the omission, and the file is outside the plan grant's files_touched. All reviewers rated this NIT.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:unblock_resolve_own_prs, lines 2414-2415 (non-404 branch lines 2421-2423) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `jq -e` check for whether to read the wait label filters only on headRefName and OPEN state, not on the head-repository and author filters that own_prs_from_graphql applies (`owner.lower() != repo.lower()`, `author.get("login") != pipeline_login`). So a fork or other-author `ai/issue-<n>` PR causes a read of MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_LABEL.
  WHY: On a non-404 read failure (403, 5xx, rate limit), the facts become `unknown` and unblock_reissue_own_pr_guard refuses with `own_pr_unknown pr=unknown`, contrary to #10241 ("is ignored by G1 to G3"). Without a failure, a fork PR still costs one unnecessary variables call. Suggested fix: add the `--arg r "${REPOSITORY}" --arg l "${UNBLOCK_LOGIN:-}"` headRepository/author conditions to the select, keeping the fail-closed path for an empty login.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "G5. ... G4 gets MERGE_LEASE_SOURCE_ISSUE_GUARD_ENABLED, default true" / "false keeps today's behaviour" / "Pass the two switches through the env: of the steps that run these scripts."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml, step env blocks at lines 267 and 1035
  Evidence of absence: The file is not touched by the PR and grep finds no MERGE_LEASE_SOURCE_ISSUE_GUARD_ENABLED in it. Its steps run merge-lease code in scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh and scripts/review_merge_train.sh, so the guard stays on there through the script default. The README and the agents.d fragment record this, and the file is outside files_touched. | severity=NIT | confidence=4
- NOTE: The pass-1 consensus finding "unblock_judge.yml missing MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_LABEL" (rated high) is no longer a defect at HEAD. Lines 2414-2427 now read the repository variable, and a non-404 failure makes the facts `unknown` instead of falling back to the default label. GH_TOKEN, `set -uo pipefail` and the inline env pass-through were checked and are safe.
- HARDENING: scripts/unblock_judge.sh, non-404 branch lines 2421-2424. Persistent 403 failures (fine-grained PAT without "Variables: read") refuse every re-issue, and the log line `op=own_prs outcome=unknown reason=label_read_failed` does not show the HTTP status. Fix: extract the status from own_label_err and add `http=<code>` to the log line (about 3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2420-2428 (within `unblock_resolve_own_prs`) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The open-PR filter that decides whether to read the `MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_LABEL` label is inefficient.
  WHY: The wait label is read whenever an open `ai/issue-<n>` PR exists, without first checking the pipeline login or the same repository. Fork and third-party PRs, which `unblock_actions.py own-prs` later ignores, therefore cause unnecessary `gh api` calls. The reviewer says this is not a functional bug but breaks the batched-read efficiency intent (G1/G5).
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2420-2428 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Unnecessary API calls for repository variables when open PR candidates exist but are not pipeline-owned (PERFORMANCE).
  WHY: The `MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_LABEL` check runs before filtering by owner/repo, causing redundant GitHub API calls for fork/third-party PRs, which breaks the G1/G5 API-efficiency design.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Pass the switches through the env of steps that run these scripts" (G5, explicitly for `MERGE_LEASE_SOURCE_ISSUE_GUARD_ENABLED`).
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml, the env mappings for the merge-lease tick and base-sync steps.
  Evidence of absence: The PR diff does not modify the file, and its merge-lease env mappings do not include `MERGE_LEASE_SOURCE_ISSUE_GUARD_ENABLED`. | severity=NIT | confidence=5
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:2414-2423, unblock_resolve_own_prs | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Any open PR with the matching head ref triggers the wait-label lookup before the head repository or author is checked. If the lookup fails for a fork or other-author PR, the code clears graphql_file and leaves own_prs unknown.
  WHY: An empty graphql_file skips the parser that filters out forks and other authors. The unknown facts then make the re-issue guard refuse, so a PR the task says to ignore blocks re-issue.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Lease tests require "switch off restores today's grant", and the switches must be passed through the env of the steps that run these scripts.
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml, the merge-lease tick and base-sync env mappings.
  Evidence of absence: The mappings at lines 263-270 and 1030-1043 pass MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED but omit MERGE_LEASE_SOURCE_ISSUE_GUARD_ENABLED, and the PR does not edit this workflow. Setting the variable to false does not reach these steps, and the script default keeps the guard on. | severity=NIT | confidence=5
=== END FINDINGS FROM openai_gpt-6-luna ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- scripts/unblock_judge.sh:lines 2414-2425 (`unblock_resolve_own_prs`, the wait-label read gate and non-404 branch) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The skip-check at line 2415 tests only `.headRefName == $h and .state == "OPEN"`, not `headRepository.nameWithOwner` or `author.login`, which `own_prs_from_graphql` in scripts/unblock_actions.py requires. Fork and other-author PRs therefore trigger the MERGE_LEASE_WAIT_LABEL read, and a non-404 failure sets `graphql_file=""` / `reason=label_read_failed` (lines 2421-2423).
  WHY: When the only open `ai/issue-<n>` node is a fork or other-author PR and the variables read fails transiently (500, 403, rate limit), `unblock_reissue_own_pr_guard` refuses with `own_pr_unknown` for as long as the outage lasts. In the normal case the cost is one extra actions/variables GET per judged issue.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "G5. … G4 gets `MERGE_LEASE_SOURCE_ISSUE_GUARD_ENABLED`, default `true`" with "Pass the two switches through the `env:` of the steps that run these scripts."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml, the env mappings at lines 267 and 1035 that already forward `MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED`.
  Evidence of absence: The switch line is added to orchestrate_poll.yml, review_autofix.yml and cancel_on_pr_close.yml, but review_autofix_sweep.yml is not modified. grep confirms neither MERGE_LEASE_REVOKE_ENABLED mapping has a matching guard line, so the sweep's merge-lease tick and final-CI base-sync keep the guard on. The omission is documented in README.md and agents.d/10241-unblock-reissue-own-pr-guard.md, which is why the reviewer rated it NIT. | severity=NIT | confidence=4
- HARDENING: scripts/unblock_judge.sh, lines 2419-2425, non-404 branch. The log line `op=own_prs outcome=unknown count=0 reason=label_read_failed` has no HTTP status, so a persistent 403 cannot be told apart from a transient 500. Fix: extract the status from `own_label_err` and append ` http=<code>` (about 3 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
